project_type: Vite + React 19 SPA, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand v5, react-i18next v16, react-router-dom v7
build_system: Vite 8 (rolldown) + tsc. Path alias '@/' maps to 'app/src/'. tsconfig.app.json has strict:true, noUnusedLocals:true, noUnusedParameters:true, exactOptionalPropertyTypes:true.
test_framework: Vitest 3 (unit, happy-dom) + Playwright 1.65 (e2e). Unit test setup: app/src/test/setup.ts mocks react-i18next, @/stores/uiStore, and @/i18n globally.
build_command: npm run build (runs: tsc -b && vite build)
test_command: npm test -- --silent (runs: vitest run --silent --reporter=dot). E2E: npx playwright test --reporter=dot
verification_instructions: 1. cd app && npm test -- --silent (unit tests, all should pass). 2. npm run build (must compile with 0 TS errors). 3. npm run lint (0 warnings allowed). 4. For e2e: start dev server (npm run dev) then npx playwright test --reporter=dot
environment_constraints: Windows (bash shell). jszip is NOT installed — FEAT-003/004 coder must run 'npm install jszip@3.10.1' first. Dev server runs on :5173. noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters are errors — remove any unused imports.
contribution_requirements: No unused imports/vars (TS errors). No duplicate backup files. Conventional commit messages. Run 'npm test -- --silent' and 'npm run build' after each FEAT.
key_patterns: Components use 'export const Foo = (): JSX.Element =>'. Stores use zustand 'create<T>()(...)' with no Provider. i18n uses global instance via useTranslation(). All text via t('key'). Tests mock i18n via setup.ts (t returns key name). Playwright tests seed localStorage with setupLocale() helper before each test. Data-testid used sparingly — prefer role/aria selectors. app/src/test/setup.ts mocks uiStore AND i18n AND react-i18next globally for all unit tests.
directory_structure: app/ — Vite project root. app/src/ — all source. app/src/pages/ — page components (HomePage, WizardPage, EditorPage, etc.). app/src/components/wizard/ — WizardStep1-3, WizardProgress. app/src/components/editor/ — TraitCard, StatusPanel, ComponentPanel, etc. app/src/components/layout/ — AppShell, Header. app/src/stores/ — only uiStore.ts exists. app/src/i18n/ — i18n init + locales/. app/src/test/ — setup.ts. app/e2e/ — Playwright specs. app/.agents/ — workflow artifacts (never committed).
